caption_or_description: AM and FM radio signals. (a) Sound waves that enter a microphone. (b) Radio-frequency carrier wave produced by a transmitter without a sound signal. (c) Carrier wave modulated by signal. (d) Static interference. (e) Carrier wave and signal affected by static. (f) Radio receiver cuts out negative half of carrier wave. (g) Signal remaining is rough for AM because of static but is smooth for FM because the tips of the waveform are clipped without loss to the signal.
